resolutions.evidence: Marriott publishes these as two properties with two per-hotel property codes (stlff, stlsu) on two first-party pages. The shared switchboard 636-519-7500 is ordinary at a dual-brand Marriott property and is not evidence of one hotel. One address, two hotels: neither is a duplicate of the other and neither may be merged or suppressed. This resolution asserts nothing about either property's policy.
resolutions.distinct_reason: a dual-brand hotel property: one site operated as two hotels under two Marriott brands, each with its own per-hotel property code, its own first-party page and its own pet policy. Marriott codes are per-hotel and no two hotels share one -- the discriminator PTF-COLUMBUS-IDENTITY-CLEANUP-001 relied on to keep three Columbus Embassy Suites apart.
